events.message: a retryable error costs one retry (1)
an error that is not retryable fails at once, with no retry
maxRetries 1 gives up after two errors
the first call writes the prefix to the cache
the same prefix, sent again, reports cache-read tokens (3973)
the cached call costs under a fifth of an uncached one ($0.00062)
a long prefix with a short answer projects $0.0101485, not the input-rate $0.0081620
a call that fits the budget alone ($0.0249) is refused ...
the refused call never reached the model
over the Messages format, an HTTP 529 costs one retry (3 requests for two calls)
over the Messages format, the first call writes the prefix
over the Messages format, the repeated prefix reads from the cache
over the Messages format, a call that fits the budget alone ($0.0249) is refused ...
... because $0.0108 is already spent, and no request was sent
